from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A party involved in the legal case."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the person or organization")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Their role in the case, e.g., Appellant, Defendant, Applicant")
    case_id: str | None = Field(description="Optional unique identifier for the party if mentioned")

class Fee(BaseModel):
    """A cost or fee associated with the case."""
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The monetary amount, e.g., '50 元'")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who is responsible for the fee, e.g., 'Appellant', 'Defendant'")
    fee_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of fee, e.g., 'Court Fee', 'Appeal Fee'")

class Outcome(BaseModel):
    """The judicial decision or ruling."""
    text: str = Field(description="The core decision text, e.g., 'Dismiss Appeal', 'Uphold Original Judgment'")
    finality: str | None = Field(description="Whether the decision is final, e.g., 'Final Judgment'")

class CaseNumber(BaseModel):
    """A legal case identifier."""
    number: str = Field(description="The full case number string")
    court: str | None = Field(description="The court that issued the case number if mentioned")

class SpecificAmount(BaseModel):
    """A specific monetary amount mentioned for compensation, fine, etc."""
    label: str = Field(description="Description of the amount, e.g., 'Compensation', 'Fine'")
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The amount value")
    direction: str | None = Field(description="Who pays or receives, e.g., 'Paid by Chen Mou 8'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Parsed information for a single document summary."""
    document_identifier: list[str] = Field(description="Identifier of the document, e.g., 'Document 1', '《判决文书 12》'")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of all parties named in the document")
    fees: list[Fee] = Field(description="List of all fees and litigation costs")
    outcomes: list[Outcome] = Field(description="List of judicial outcomes or dispositions")
    case_numbers: list[CaseNumber] = Field(description="List of all case numbers mentioned")
    specific_amounts: list[SpecificAmount] = Field(description="List of specific monetary amounts for compensation, fines, etc.")
